description: Fetch a single OQMD material by its entry_id (e.g. 16525 = the Pbcn polymorph of Fe2O3). Returns formation energy (eV/atom), stability above hull, band gap, space group, prototype, cell volume, atom/element counts, ICSD id, and generic composition. Keyless.

entry_id.description: OQMD entry_id, e.g. 16525 (Fe2O3, Pbcn). Get ids from search_materials results.

title: Get Material
